blocks.x: DORA-grade resilience posture, third-party and incident evidence automated
Identity withheld, A tier-1 US bank, Banking & Financial Services sector, outcome-linked engagement, blended delivery team. Figures are the client's own, shared with permission.
ICT third-party register spread across procurement spreadsheets; incident playbooks untested for years.
Evidence for resilience assessments assembled manually per audit; findings recurred without owners. Board reporting on resilience was narrative, not measured.

We implemented the resilience program on Sentinel: the third-party register became a governed data product with tiering and exit evidence, incident playbooks moved to tested runbooks with two full exercises per year, and control tests ran continuously with failing-control workflows. The board pack now reports measured recovery times and coverage gaps.

blocks.x: What would change in your estate

Colleagues ask what the tier-1 US bank program proves. It proves the pattern works when the baseline is honest; it cannot prove your numbers, which is exactly why the diagnostic comes first The engagement model here was build-run (managed); the same pattern runs fixed-scope where the estate allows it.
Figures on this page are the client's, reproduced with permission. Method notes and measurement designs are available under NDA.
Start with the diagnostic, not the contract: the same diagnostic baselined in two weeks, and a scoped proposal only if the delta justifies it.
